description: This Java class 'DefaultMetricsConfig' implements the 'MetricsConfig' interface, providing configuration settings for metrics, including enabling system metrics, Prometheus metrics, and related hostname and port. It includes methods for instantiation from a Config object, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetricsConfig, encapsulating metrics configuration parameters such as system metrics, Prometheus enablement, hostname, and port.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMetricsConfig from a given Config object, using ConfigWithFallback to handle configuration fallback.

methods.name: isSystemMetricsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether system metrics are enabled.

methods.name: isPrometheusEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether Prometheus metrics are enabled.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on configuration fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the configuration.
